Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a biotin-streptavidin pulldown (AP-MS) to identify proteins ligated to peptides on the surface of extracellular vesicles. The MS analysis was performed using DDA (TOP20) and LFQ quantification.

scope: To identify proteins on RBCEVs that were ligated to the biotinylated peptide, we pulled down the biotinylated peptide-ligated RBCEV proteins using streptavidin magnetic beads and analyzed precipitated proteins using label-free quantitative mass spectrometry

The lysate from each sample was incubated with streptavidin-magnetic beads from the Pierce MS-Compatible Magnetic IP Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) for 1 h to allow binding of biotinylated proteins to the beads.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis focused on proteins affinity-purified via streptavidin beads from biotinylated peptide-ligated RBCEVs. While the input material was extracellular vesicles (EVs), the specific material analyzed by MS was the affinity-purified complex.
